result.brief: 提出物理状态驱动的图像到视频生成框架，用显式动力学预测生成稀疏轨迹与稠密区域运动先验来引导扩散采样，提升碰撞运动的物理一致性。
result.reason: Physics-state-driven image-to-video diffusion with trajectory and dense motion priors; contributes motion guidance for video generation, with physics rollout as conditioning rather than a learned world model.
